summary: The recorded base reproduces all four inconsistent routings and the leading-newline marker leak. The exact candidate makes one-shot and streaming output invariant, removes the opening marker, routes pre-marker text to content unless reasoning was forced, and preserves incomplete marker prefixes at stream end. Candidate regressions, the full reasoning-parser unit file, exhaustive character-boundary partitions of representative short inputs, buffered streaming, incomplete-prefix cases, and Gemma4's compound opening marker all passed.

tests.what_was_measured: Reproduced the original four-way divergence and newline marker leak on the exact recorded base; adversarial assertions intentionally failed on the unfixed implementation.
Original reproduction plus every character-boundary partition for representative normal and forced reasoning strings, truncated blocks, and incomplete/aborted opening-marker prefixes.
Candidate-authored regression against the exact candidate checkout.
Independent buffered-streaming and Gemma4 compound opening-marker boundary cases.

gpu_execution.evidence: The reported defect and regression are deterministic CPU-only string parsing; no model, kernel, or GPU execution path is involved.

remaining_limitations: No full model-serving run was performed; the original issue is entirely reproducible through the parser API without model weights.
No GPU validation was performed because it would not exercise additional issue-specific code.
No native rebuild was performed because the candidate changes only Python parser and test files and repository-environment.json declares no native artifact.
